introduction: Medical Assistance and MinnesotaCare provide health coverage for eligible Minnesota residents. The application route depends on age and care needs.
description: Medical Assistance and MinnesotaCare provide health coverage for eligible Minnesota residents. The application route depends on age and care needs.

sections.who: Household income, residency, age and pregnancy affect eligibility. Immigration rules differ by category; use DHS’s current noncitizen guidance.
sections.get: Medical Assistance and MinnesotaCare offer health coverage at little or no cost. MinnesotaCare premiums and copays can apply.
sections.docs:

  • Requested identity and eligibility records.
sections.apply:
1. Choose the application

    Visit DHS online access. Individuals under 65 and families use Resident login; separate links serve older, blind, disabled or long-term-care applicants.

  2. Submit and save

    Create the appropriate account, complete the application and save its confirmation.

  3. Respond to verification

    Read requests from the agency and send the requested records.
sections.after: Review the decision and coverage start date; report changes and complete renewals as directed.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using DHS health application and eligibility; MNsure application routes. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Do older applicants use the same route?
Are income limits the same for everyone?
No. Age, pregnancy and household circumstances matter.
Does applying mean coverage starts immediately?
Read the agency’s decision and start date.
